Rooted in Valley Center

A Real Farm, A Real Team, A Real Answer

Since brothers Jerome and Noel Stehly reimagined this multi-generation farm in 2002, we've kept things simple: grow good organic food sustainably, and make it easy for our neighbors to get it. That includes making sure you can always reach a real person about your CSA share, an event booking, or a farm store question.
